name: Röttger et al. Rendering
aliases: Röttger et al. Rendering — 3D Texture Volume Rendering with Pre-Integration
definition: Uses a 3D texture map parameterized by front scalar value, back scalar value, and thickness to look up the volume rendering integral for an arbitrary transfer function, which may include isosurface effects.
summary: Röttger et al. Rendering is an object-order technique using pre-integrated 3D lookup tables to enable hardware-accelerated rendering of arbitrary transfer functions without artifacts.
